definition: Auto-WEKA is an automated machine learning system based on Weka by Chris Thornton, Frank Hutter, Holger H.
details: Hoos and Kevin Leyton-Brown. An extended version was published as Auto-WEKA 2.0. Auto-WEKA was named the first prominent AutoML system in a neutral comparison study. It received the test-of-time award of the SIGKDD conference in 2023.

explainer.lead: Auto-WEKA is an automated machine-learning system built on Weka. It reduces the manual work of choosing a learning method and its settings, and its influence was recognized with SIGKDD's test-of-time award in 2023.

tiers.eli5: Choosing a machine-learning method is a bit like trying many recipes and adjusting their ingredients until one works well. Auto-WEKA does much of that trying and adjusting for you inside Weka. You still provide the problem and data, but it helps find a suitable way to learn from them.
tiers.practitioner: Use Auto-WEKA in Weka-based workflows when you want to automate the choice of learning approach and configuration instead of tuning everything manually. Treat its result as a candidate that still needs checking on the intended task and deployment conditions. Auto-WEKA 2.0 is the extended version.
tiers.paperLevel: Auto-WEKA is an AutoML system over Weka: given a learning task, it automates the selection of a suitable machine-learning approach and its configuration rather than requiring both to be fixed manually. It was developed by Chris Thornton, Frank Hutter, Holger H. Hoos and Kevin Leyton-Brown, with an extended version published as Auto-WEKA 2.0. A neutral comparison study named it the first prominent AutoML system, and it received SIGKDD's test-of-time award in 2023.

explainer.example: For a labelled table of customer records used to predict churn, Auto-WEKA can explore Weka learning methods and their settings instead of requiring the user to configure each candidate manually. It then returns a selected setup for that prediction task.

usedIn.name: Weka-based machine learning
usedIn.detail: Automates method selection and configuration within the Weka environment.

usedIn.name: AutoML research
usedIn.detail: Serves as an early prominent system included in a neutral comparison study.

explainer.intuition: Many machine-learning projects require two linked choices: which method to use and how to configure it. Auto-WEKA automates that search so users do not have to try every combination by hand.
howItWorks: Start with a machine-learning task and its data.
Consider alternative learning approaches available through Weka.
Explore different settings for those approaches.
Compare candidate setups on the task.
Return a selected Weka learning setup for the user.
explainer.whyItMatters: It brought automation to a time-consuming part of practical machine learning and became an early prominent AutoML system. Its lasting research importance was marked by SIGKDD's test-of-time award in 2023.
misconceptions: Auto-WEKA is not one new learning algorithm; it automates choices among machine-learning approaches and settings.
Auto-WEKA 2.0 is an extended version of Auto-WEKA, not an unrelated system.
